name: Korra for Energy and Investment Projects (S.A.E.)
source: Korra Energi issuer announcement (IP0 press release, 18 May 2026) and Year in Review 2024 report
source_note: Issuer figures. FY2025 revenue approximately EGP 7.9bn and FY2025 net profit approximately EGP 554mn are from the company's own IPO announcement; FY2025 gross profit EGP 1.6bn (18.6 percent margin) and the FY2024 revenue of approximately EGP 5.7bn and FY2023 revenue of EGP 4,074mn are from the issuer's Year in Review 2024 report. Cost of Sales for FY2025 is derived as Revenue minus Gross Profit (identity holds). No issuer-published figures were found for the remaining rows, so they are omitted rather than estimated.
